title:
Fix crosslink #275 (HIGH, anti-Goodhart soundness hole): the solver-vacuity checks silently no-op on every struct/enum-returning fn. Two coupled bugs in forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs: (1) extract_lowered_fn (~line 311) builds the tautology/vacuous-precondition harness sub-program from spec_items + the target fn but does NOT weave in the reachable ADT (struct/enum) declarations the fn's params/result/body reference, so an ADT-returning (or ADT-taking) fn's harness fails to COMPILE with E0425 'cannot find type/value'; (2) interpret_summary (~line 595) maps a rustc/verus summary of success:false / errors:0 to HarnessOutcome::Failed, which the vacuity logic reads as a CLEAN pass — so the E0425 compile error reads as 'not a tautology / not vacuous' and BOTH checks silently no-op. Net: every ADT-returning fn (the whole editor example) bypasses both anti-Goodhart vacuity checks. This is an R-CODE-4 'non-verdict read as clean' violation. Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails.

STANDING SELF-VERIFY RULES: run python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and RE-PIN the audited-sha of EVERY design doc whose governed source you touch; run req-registry.py --check; finish 0-drift. EVERY new test that invokes verus/lake MUST open with the verus_present()/lake_present() skip-guard like the sibling tests (CI test-shards lack the spine; the lean job runs them — F4/#309 just landed).

SCOPE: the #275 fix ONLY — do NOT widen to other vacuity work (#271 spec-tightness is separate). The fix has two parts:
1. WEAVE THE ADT DEPS: extend the harness sub-program construction so it includes the struct/enum definitions reachable from the target fn's signature + body (mirror however reachable SPEC-FN deps are already woven — there is likely an existing reachable-deps closure for spec fns; extend it to ADTs, or add a reachable_adt_deps pass). The harness for an ADT-returning fn must now COMPILE.
2. DISTINGUISH COMPILE-ERROR FROM VERIFICATION-FAILED: a harness that fails to COMPILE/elaborate (E0425, unresolved name, parse/VIR error) is a HARNESS CONSTRUCTION error → a loud ForgeError (the harness must be well-formed for the vacuity verdict to mean anything), NEVER HarnessOutcome::Failed→Clean. Only a genuine verus verification 'failed' (the harness compiled, the obligation was checked and not proved) is the Failed/Clean signal. Make interpret_summary (or its caller) separate these. Preserve the existing inverted-verdict logic for genuine results (tautology: Verus PROVES the empty-body harness → reject; vacuous req: assert(false) PROVES → reject).

DELIVERABLES / TESTS (verus-gated, guarded): an ADT-returning fn with a body-ignoring/tautological ens is now REJECTED as a tautology (not silently clean); a vacuous-precondition ADT-taking fn is rejected; a harness that cannot be constructed surfaces a ForgeError, never a clean verdict. Pin each with a test (verus_present-guarded). Confirm the previously-no-op scalar path is byte-unchanged (existing vacuity conformance certs stay byte-identical).

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge; clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; doc-drift 0-drift; req-registry --check clean; conformance oracle byte-identical for existing items. No stubs/TODOs.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage/combinator-menu change; do NOT flip the README/docs headline; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. NOTE: git push is blocked for you by policy — commit locally, end with a clear summary, the orchestrator pushes + opens the PR. One branch; ONE fix (#275).
